entries.claim: Statcounter shows Indonesia's mobile web traffic at Android 77.07% and iOS 22.88% in August 2026, well below the 87-90% Android figures quoted by two vendors.
entries.appliesWhen: Web-traffic share; game revenue split not measured.

support.excerpt: Aug 2026: Android 77.07%, iOS 22.88%.

counterSupport.excerpt: Android dominates the Indonesian market with almost 90% market share as of October 2022.

entries.useFor: Android is still the majority store; do not use 90% as the planning number.
entries.researcherNote: Vendor figures are older (AppTweak: almost 90% as of Oct 2022; LocalizeDirect: 87%, undated).

entries.claim: Indonesia led Southeast Asia in game downloads in Q1 2025 with 870 million (up 9% quarter on quarter) and held 41% of regional downloads in Jan-Aug 2024.
entries.appliesWhen: Sensor Tower download estimates, both stores.

support.excerpt: Indonesia stands out as the leader in mobile game downloads, reaching 870 million in Q1 2025.
Indonesia 41% of the total downloads in SEA (Jan-Aug 2024).

entries.useFor: Indonesia is a volume market: large installs, thin revenue per install.

entries.claim: In the 22 top-grossing games on Indonesia Google Play (26 Sep 2026 chart), the first phone screenshot set was landscape in 13 and portrait in 9; the median was 7 screenshots (range 4 to 14).
entries.appliesWhen: Top-grossing games of all genres in Indonesia.

support.excerpt: 13 landscape, 9 portrait; median 7; range 4 to 14.

entries.useFor: The top-grossing norm is landscape; portrait is common in casual and the Habby competitors.
entries.researcherNote: Chart order from Similarweb (used only to pick packages). Single snapshot of one chart on one day; chart mix is dominated by MOBA, battle-royale, casual and card games, not roguelikes. Orientation is genre-driven.

entries.claim: AppTweak says Indonesian app creatives favour portrait screenshots and neon colours with gradients (electric blue, bright red, magenta, bright purple); its statement is about apps generally, not games.
entries.appliesWhen: Observational; last updated 2024-02; not specific to games.

support.excerpt: Portrait orientation screenshots ... Neon colors with gradients are particularly popular.

counterSupport.excerpt: 13 of 22 top-grossing Indonesian games use a landscape first screenshot set.

entries.useFor: Do not treat neon-gradient portrait as an Indonesia rule for games.
entries.researcherNote: Not confirmed for games: in the top-grossing games chart landscape is more common (see as-id-003).

entries.claim: Indonesian captions are commonly Indonesian mixed with English game terms: AppTweak says screenshots mix the two languages, and viewed top-grossing listings (Mobile Legends, Ragnarok, PUBG Mobile, Clash of Clans, Whiteout Survival, Higgs Domino) use Indonesian captions with English names and terms.
entries.appliesWhen: Indonesia top-grossing listings; captions read by eye on six.

support.excerpt: Screenshot captions frequently mix Indonesian and English text.
Six viewed listings use Indonesian captions; PUBG keeps English headlines with Indonesian sub-lines.

entries.useFor: Bilingual captions are locally normal; keep genre words (Hero, Class, PvP, Boss) in English if that is how players say them.
entries.researcherNote: Two origins; the vendor claim covers apps generally.

entries.claim: Habby's Capybara Go, Archero 2 and Survivor.io use Indonesian captions on their Indonesian Google Play screenshots, while keeping the Latin game name.

support.excerpt: id listings show Indonesian headlines and Latin game names.

entries.useFor: Competitors localise the caption layer only for Indonesia.

entries.claim: Archero 2's Indonesian listing has Spanish text on screenshot 3: the caption reads 'Combos de Habilidad Infinitos / ¡Suerte + Habilidad = Dominación!' and the in-game UI is Spanish ('¡Has conocido a un ángel!').
entries.appliesWhen: Archero 2 listing as of 2026-09-29. The Thai listing's equivalent image shows Thai UI text.

support.excerpt: id set image 3: Spanish caption and Spanish UI text, while other id captions are Indonesian.

entries.useFor: Have a native reviewer check every caption and the UI language in each screenshot before upload.
entries.researcherNote: Direct observation, viewed at 900 px; a localisation QA slip at a top competitor, not a market convention.

entries.claim: AppTweak reports that about 54% of the top 500 Indonesian games include a promotional video, compared with 24% of apps.
entries.appliesWhen: Snapshot from the 2022-2024 period (article last updated 2024-02).

support.excerpt: Approximately 54% of top 500 games include promotional videos, compared to just 24% of apps.

entries.useFor: A promo video is the majority practice in Indonesian top games.

entries.claim: AppTweak found that only 2 of the top 10 free and grossing Indonesian games have no multiplayer component.

support.excerpt: Only 2 in the top 10 free and grossing games do not include any multiplayer component.

entries.useFor: A solo roguelike may need to show social/PvP hooks in its Indonesian listing.

entries.claim: Indonesia's Communications Ministry Regulation No. 2 of 2024 requires the game classification certificate to be quoted in packaging, game descriptions, advertising and digital storefronts.
entries.appliesWhen: IGRS; wording as reported Dec 2025. Enforcement currently suspended (see as-id-011).

support.excerpt: The classification certificate must then be quoted in all relevant packaging, game descriptions, advertising, digital storefronts and official distribution platforms.

entries.useFor: Plan to show an IGRS rating in Indonesian descriptions and ads once the system is reactivated.
entries.researcherNote: Law-firm newsletter, pre-suspension. The regulation text itself was not read.

entries.claim: Komdigi temporarily suspended IGRS rating processes on 17 April 2026 and as of 9 August 2026 said reactivation was targeted for 2026 without a firm date.
entries.appliesWhen: Government statements; status may have changed after 2026-09-29.

support.excerpt: Sambil menunggu semua proses investigasi dan evaluasi selesai, kami memutuskan untuk menunda sementara proses rating IGRS secara keseluruhan.
Reaktivasi pasti setelah semuanya selesai baru kembali dilakukan.
IGRS reactivation targeted for 2026 after comprehensive evaluation.
IGRS temporarily suspended by Komdigi on 17 April 2026.

counterSupport.excerpt: IGRS has been fully enforced since January 24, 2026, meaning every game accessible in Indonesia must have an official age rating.

entries.useFor: Do not build an Indonesia rating badge into store art yet; re-check before launch.
entries.researcherNote: Contradicted by Cekindo (3 Aug 2026), which says IGRS has been fully enforced since 24 Jan 2026 and omits the suspension; government-quoting outlets are treated as more reliable.

entries.claim: During the IGRS suspension the ministry said it would not block or restrict access to unrated games in Indonesia.

support.excerpt: tidak akan memblokir atau membatasi akses terhadap gim-gim tanpa rating.
will not block or restrict access to unrated games circulating in Indonesia.
tetap bisa main ... ga ada yang diblokir game-game.

entries.useFor: No IGRS rating is needed on a listing today; a future reactivation could change this.
entries.researcherNote: The two 9 Aug articles share one Komdigi statement; the April CNBC article is a separate statement (two origins).

entries.claim: IGRS's April 2026 rollout produced erratic ratings on Steam (for example Call of Duty 3+, Story of Seasons 18+) that Komdigi called unofficial, and Steam removed the IGRS ratings.
entries.appliesWhen: Steam rating display; Google Play not involved in the reported incident.

support.excerpt: April 2-5, 2026: erratic classifications; April 6: Komdigi says ratings unofficial; Steam removes IGRS ratings.

entries.useFor: Shows the rating regime is unstable; avoid depending on IGRS labels.
entries.researcherNote: Single Niko Partners timeline; Google Play/IARC handling not covered.

entries.claim: On 16 September 2026 Komdigi gave 25 private-scope electronic system operators until 22 September to register (PSE) or face warnings and termination of service access.
entries.appliesWhen: Announced to 25 named sectors (transport, e-commerce, property, professional services); no games among them.

support.excerpt: penerapan sanksi administratif berupa pemutusan akses layanan.

entries.useFor: PSE registration is a live obligation; confirm the publisher's status before launch.
entries.researcherNote: Shows the enforcement mechanism (access termination); it does not show games being targeted.

entries.claim: A compliance consultancy says PSE licensing applies to games with user accounts, in-app purchases, online access or user interaction, and that games without PSE or IGRS compliance risk warnings, fines, delisting or blocking.

support.excerpt: PSE license applies if a game includes features such as user accounts, in-app purchases, online access, personal data processing, or user interactions.

entries.useFor: Treat as a checklist item, not an authoritative interpretation.
entries.researcherNote: Vendor source; also asserts IGRS is fully enforced, which conflicts with government statements.

entries.claim: Garena ran a large Ramadan 2026 Free Fire event in Indonesia (19 Feb to 5 Mar, in-game Ramadan tokens donated via four creators, over Rp650 million, plus a THR voucher raffle).
entries.appliesWhen: Publisher event coverage; effect on installs or store conversion not measured.

support.excerpt: Event started 2026-02-19; donation period 25 Feb - 5 Mar 2026; donation over Rp650 million; THR Voucher raffle 6-24 March.

entries.useFor: Ramadan is a major event season; assume big publishers run themed creatives.
entries.researcherNote: Publisher-driven news; no effect data found.

entries.claim: AppTweak notes Indonesian apps change icons during Ramadan with elements reminiscent of Islam (Muslims are about 87% of the population).

support.excerpt: Apps celebrate religious observances - updating icons during Ramadan with elements reminiscent of Islam.

entries.useFor: A Ramadan icon variant is a cheap test, not a proven lift.

entries.claim: Indonesia scores 471 in EF EPI 2025 (80th globally, Low band).

support.excerpt: Indonesia (471) fell into the low-proficiency band.

entries.useFor: English-only captions are risky; local leaders localise.

entries.claim: Indonesian text runs about 8-12% longer than English (AppTweak); another vendor says Indonesian phrases take more space without a figure.

support.excerpt: Indonesian is between 8% and 12% longer to write than English.
Indonesian phrases take more space; use dynamic resizing.
